US States Halt Paramount-Warner Merger Amid Competition Concerns

A US judge has ordered Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery to pause their proposed $81 billion merger for at least two weeks. The halt was granted at the request of California and 11 other states, who argue the deal would significantly reduce competition in the US media and entertainment sector.
